query: SELECT id AS "id!: ContactId" FROM ((SELECT id FROM contacts WHERE (id < $3) AND ($3 IS NOT NULL) AND ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contact_flags f WHERE f.contact_id = contacts.id) >= $1) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $2) UNION ALL (SELECT id FROM contacts WHERE ($3 IS NULL) AND ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contact_flags f WHERE f.contact_id = contacts.id) >= $1) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $2) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $2) __ids ORDER BY id DESC
